preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of cells in the grid for each test case must be between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i][j] in {'.', '#'} for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either empty ('.') or contain a wall ('#').

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of airstrikes required to reach (N, M) from (1, 1).
